$note: The ceiling on what this repository costs an agent before any work happens.
Read by check-context-floor.mjs; the rules are in context-floor.mjs.
To raise a ceiling: change the number, change `set` to today, and write the
sentence in `why` that justifies it. That sentence is the whole mechanism.
The number is cheap to change and it is SUPPOSED to be — what this check
buys is that changing it leaves a record, which 27 days of monotonic growth
in the predecessor's CLAUDE.md never did.
Lowering a ceiling after a cut is the same edit and needs the same sentence.
A ceiling left far above the measurement is a check that has stopped
`measuredWhenSet` is part of the record, not decoration. Leaving it stale
turns the `why` below into a paragraph about a tree that no longer exists.
why: RAISED 2026-10-08, CLAUDE.md 4.200 to 4.250: the rule that a brief of more
than three Tasks runs as director in checkpoints too (brief
2026-10-08-director-handoff), one paragraph in How to ask. That is 4.230
measured; the listing is unchanged at 487.
RAISED 2026-10-08, CLAUDE.md 4.120 to 4.200: the from-zero pipeline. Six
skills landed name-only (stack, look-and-feel, headless, breakpoints,
app-shell, sandbox), and a name-only skill routes nothing on its own, so
each got a row saying which stage it is, plus one sentence pointing at
docs/foundation/pipeline.md. That is 4.165 measured; the rest is room for
the client intake's line at step 0. The listing is 24 skills, ten of them
name-only, and it went DOWN to 487 against its 500: five descriptions were
cut to the 120 characters the harness keeps, which paid for the six names.
RAISED 2026-10-03, CLAUDE.md 4.110 to 4.120: the interactions skill's row
in the skills table, which check:skills-table demands of every skill on
disk. The two tokens over were that row and nothing more.
RAISED 2026-09-30, CLAUDE.md 4.100 to 4.110: the component-props skill's
row in the skills table, which check:skills-table demands of every skill
on disk. The ten tokens are that row and nothing more.
THE FIRST CEILING, set the day the repository was created.
CLAUDE.md was written from scratch rather than pruned out of the 27.753-byte
file it descends from, and it measures 3.861 tokens against that file's
7.501 — 51 per cent. What is absent is the whole of one client's design
system: a token ladder, a chart registry, a metered design-tool budget, a
product roster, and thirteen measured gotchas about packages this project
does not install.
The ceiling is 4.100, about 240 tokens — roughly 900 bytes, two or three
bullets — of room. That is the same headroom the predecessor set every time:
enough to repair a sentence or add a rule, not enough to add a section.
THE LISTING is twelve skills, four of them name-only. The ceiling is 500,
which is the measurement plus room for one more described skill. A skill
that loses its description needs a reacher in the same change — the router,
or a sentence in CLAUDE.md at the point the condition occurs. A cut with no
route is the failure check:skills-table cannot see, because it demands a
reacher only of a skill the agent cannot see at all, and name-only is
visible.
The MCP tool DEFINITIONS, not their names. What the harness injects per tool
is the name, the description and the input schema, which is what
`pnpm check:floor --mcp` measures by asking each server in `.mcp.json` for
its tools/list. It is a flag because measuring means spawning the server.
This repository declares NO server as of 2026-10-09, so the measurement is
zero and the ceiling is a budget rather than a record. 1.600 is about eight
tools of ordinary size — a server added to `.mcp.json` is paid on every call
by everyone who clones, which makes it the same kind of edit as a section
added to CLAUDE.md.
Not measured, deliberately: a connector wired into a person's own client. It
is real cost and it is not versioned here, so a ceiling over it would be a
number this repository cannot hold anybody to.
Held by memory-index-guard.cjs at the write, not by this check: the index
lives outside the repository, per person and per machine.
It is injected whole on every call, like CLAUDE.md. It reached 5.320 tokens
and was cut by hand to 2.870 on 2026-09-30, one line per memory saying when
to read it. 3.200 is that plus about ten lines. 140 characters is the
longest line then plus room for a title; a line over it is carrying the
memory's content instead of its file.
